newsitem.title: CROATIA: Bill volume shrinks at Croatia cent bank auction.
newsitem.headline: Bill volume shrinks at Croatia cent bank auction.

text.p: The volume of bills sold at Croatia's central bank primary bill auction fell to 67 million kuna on Wednesday from 162 million last week as the banking sector remained short of funds to invest.
"Liquidity is still very strained, it has been for the past five days or so," a bank official told Reuters.
She said this prevented commercial banks which had 17 million kuna in old bills expiring today from reinvesting the money in new maturities.
The 35-day bill rate was flat at 7.0 percent and the bank received no bids for its 91-day and less popular 182-day paper. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
